title: Discord component contract for 1v1 decline and TagDuel lobby cancellation
priority: P1 — verify that public decline/cancel buttons use the real Discord component handlers, commit terminal state, release physical locks and remove stale controls.
coverage: duelUI.invitationMessage → canonical duel:decline button → handleDuelComponent → declineChallenge
tagUI.tagPublicMessage → canonical tag:cancel button → handleTagComponent → quitTag
terminal public payloads validate through validateDiscordPayload and expose zero active components
stale button replay is rejected and cannot reacquire locks or mutate player assets
isolation: Fake Discord interactions with actual discord.js builders/handlers; temporary SQLite database; Discord credentials removed.
limitations: Handlers, builders e payloads reais são executados offline com interações falsas; não há gateway, token ou guild Discord real.
Testa decline/cancel de convite/lobby; não substitui teste de publicação de mensagens na produção.
Nenhuma carta é integrada ou certificada.
